# An amCharts chart's text ignores the page's Neo theme

Owner: Vega. Not curated for contributors: #21367 names Vega for this band's engine defects, and the Charts renewal waits on this fix before the Sun 22 Nov lock.

## Context

On 18 Nov the slate read of the Charts group found the amCharts pie in `examples/charts` drawing no text: nine legend squares without names and no slice labels, while its tooltip carried the data (`Lithuania: 30.5% (501.9)`), at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844 (defect-note `a2375219`). #21367 files each engine defect as a leaf before its card's renewal. This is the first leaf of Charts part 2.

## The Problem

Measured on `dev` `d4c33ec3bc` in Chrome, `examples/charts/index.html`:

- The chart's SVG holds 28 `<text>` nodes with their strings (`Lithuania: 30.5%`, `Czech Republic: 18.3%`, …). Each is 16 px, visible, opacity 1, and has a real box (`getBBox` 121 × 18).
- Their computed fill is `rgb(255, 255, 255)`, inherited from a `<g fill="#ffffff">` that amCharts writes.
- The body is `neo-theme-light` on `rgb(250, 250, 250)`. Every label is white on near-white. The tooltip draws its own background, so it stays readable.

The cause is in the main-thread addon: `Neo.main.addon.AmCharts#create` calls `am4core.useTheme(am4themes_dark)` before every chart (`src/main/addon/AmCharts.mjs:149`), whatever theme the page or the component uses. Once registered, the dark theme stays in amCharts' global list (`am4core.registry.themes`), so every later chart in that window is created dark.

The consumers and their themes:
- `examples/charts`: no `themes` in its `neo-config.json`, so the light theme comes first.
- `apps/covid`, `apps/sharedcovid`: `["neo-theme-dark", "neo-theme-light"]`.
- `apps/colors`: `["neo-theme-dark"]`.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: "Maps a Neo theme onto one of {@link #editorThemes}." (`Neo.component.wrapper.MonacoEditor#themeMap`, `src/component/wrapper/MonacoEditor.mjs:121`). `Neo.component.wrapper.Mermaid#themeMap` and `#resolveTheme` have the same shape: a wrapper around a third-party renderer resolves its library's theme from the Neo theme through a `themeMap` config.

- `Neo.component.wrapper.AmChart` (App worker) creates its chart through the addon in `afterSetMounted`. It passes `{config, package, type, combineSeriesTooltip, data}` and no theme.
- `Neo.component.Base#getTheme()` (`src/component/Base.mjs:1652`) resolves the component's `theme`, else a `neo-theme-*` class up the parent chain, else the window's `themes[0]`.
- amCharts 4 applies themes when it creates an object, and `am4core.unuseAllThemes()` clears the global list. A chart therefore has to be created in its theme, and a theme change on a mounted chart means creating it again.

## The Fix

1. `Neo.component.wrapper.AmChart`:
   - a `themeMap` config: `neo-theme-cyberpunk`, `neo-theme-dark` and `neo-theme-neo-dark` → `'dark'`; `neo-theme-light` and `neo-theme-neo-light` → `null` (amCharts' own light default);
   - a `resolveTheme()` reading `themeMap[getTheme()]`;
   - `create` receives the resolved `theme`;
   - `afterSetTheme` creates a mounted chart again when the resolved theme changes.
2. `Neo.main.addon.AmCharts#create`: clear the global theme list, apply only the requested theme (`'dark'` → `am4themes_dark`), then create.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.component.wrapper.AmChart#themeMap` (new config) | `MonacoEditor#themeMap`, `Mermaid#themeMap` | maps a `neo-theme-*` name to an amCharts theme name, or `null` | an unmapped theme resolves to `null`, amCharts' light default; a consumer extends the map | the config's JSDoc | AC-2 |
| `Neo.main.addon.AmCharts#create(data)`, new optional `data.theme` | this ticket | `'dark'` creates this chart with `am4themes_dark`, and no theme carries over to the next chart | absent or `null` → amCharts' default | the method's JSDoc | AC-3 |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `examples/charts` draws its legend names and slice labels readable: a dark fill under `neo-theme-light` and a light fill under `neo-theme-dark`, each with contrast ≥ 4.5:1 against the page background. Red on `dev` under the light theme.
- [ ] AC-2: A unit arm resolves the chart theme for each shipped Neo theme, and for a chart that inherits its theme from a parent's `neo-theme-*` class.
- [ ] AC-3: A unit arm creates two charts in a row with different themes through the addon (an `am4core` stub): each is created in its own theme, and the light one inherits nothing from the dark one.
- [ ] AC-4: Setting `theme` on a mounted chart creates it again in the new theme (unit arm on the wrapper with the addon stubbed).

## Out of Scope

- An amCharts v5 port (Discussion #20309).
- The COVID apps' theme button. It swaps the `neo-theme-*` class in its MainContainer's `cls` and never sets `theme`, so a mounted chart keeps the theme it was created in. That is today's behaviour, unchanged here; it gets a defect-note.
- The Charts card itself (record, cover, layout): the next leaf of #21367.

## Avoided Traps

- A substring test on the theme name: `neo-theme-cyberpunk` is dark and its name does not say so (the reason `MonacoEditor#themeMap` is a map).
- Recolouring text through CSS (`svg text {fill: …}`): amCharts writes fills as attributes on its groups, so a stylesheet would fight every chart's own colours, labels inside slices included.
- Keeping `useTheme` without clearing the list: once one dark chart exists in a window, every chart created after it is dark too.

* fix(charts): an amCharts chart draws its text in its Neo theme's colours (#21400)

The AmCharts addon registered am4themes_dark before every chart, so on a
light theme every label and legend name was white on near-white.

wrapper.AmChart now takes its amCharts theme from getTheme() through a
themeMap, as the Monaco and Mermaid wrappers do, sends it with each create,
and creates a mounted chart again when that theme changes. The addon gives
each chart its own theme list and leaves amCharts' global list empty, so no
chart inherits the theme of the one created before it.

* fix(charts): a cancelled chart create never reaches the main thread (#21400)

AmChart#createChart cancels the create it still holds through the AbortSignal that timeout() takes, and so do an unmount and destroy(). A theme change or an unmount inside the 50 ms window therefore sends at most the newest create. AmCharts#create disposes a chart already under the same id, and unregisters the themes in a finally, so a throwing create leaves none behind.
